item.title: Casual employees, Daily wagers seeking regularisation of services Protest in Srinagar
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 16 : A large number of daily wagers and contractual employees took out a protest march here on Monday to demand regularisation of their services in the Jammu and Kashmir government. The protesters marched from Nawa-i-Subah complex to TRC crossing, raising slogans in support of their demand for regularisation of their services in the government. item.title: J-K: Khelo India Winter Games starting from Feb 23, raises hopes of tourism revival in Gulmarg
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 16: The Khelo India Winter Games, starting from February 23 and to be held at Kashmir’s Gulmarg, will witness participation from more than 700 athletes and officials, officials said. “There has been good snowfall this winter, which is a boost for skiing and sledging activities. item.title: New Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly complex to be ready by October 2027, says Dy. CM Surinder Choudhary.
item.description: Jammu, Feb 16: Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Kumar Choudhary on Monday inspected the ongoing construction of the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly complex and said the project is slated for completion by October next year. item.title: Woman held with Narcotics in Jammu Kashmir
item.description: Jammu,Feb 17: Police in Samba district of Jammu Kashmir arrested a woman on Tuesday for drug peddling and recovered 6.40 grams of a heroin-like substance, commonly known as chitta, from her possession in the Vijaypur area of the district. Officials said the arrest was made during routine naka checking at Rakh Barotain road near the AIIMS residential complex in Vijaypur. item.title: 24 of 44 PSUs in J-K loss-making, four non-functional: UT govt to Assembly
item.description: Jammu, Feb 17 : Out of the 44 public sector undertakings in Jammu and Kashmir, 24 are making losses and four are non-functional, the Union Territory government informed the Assembly on Tuesday. The government said it is examining ways to strengthen the sick PSUs and improve their operational and financial performance. item.title: J&K records Rs 24,080.79 cr GST collection in three years, gets Rs 15,795.13 cr IGST share: CM
item.description: Jammu, Feb 17 :Jammu and Kashmir recorded a steady rise in GST collections, with total revenue amounting to Rs 24,080.79 crore over the past three financial years, reflecting improved compliance and a widening tax base, the UT government said on Tuesday. item.title: J-K: Three apprehended with brown sugar-like substance in Baramulla
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 17 : Jammu and Kashmir Police on Tuesday apprehended three alleged drug peddlers from Pattan area of Baramulla district. item.title: PDP MLA seeks all-party meet on free Trade Agreements, flags threat to J-K’s Horticulture sector
item.description: Jammu, Feb 17 : Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) MLA Waheed Ur Rehman Para on Tuesday pressed for convening an all-party meeting to discuss the impact of free trade agreements with foreign countries on Jammu and Kashmir’s horticulture sector, particularly the apple industry. item.title: IED found on Srinagar-Baramulla highway in J-K
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 18: Security forces neutralised an Improvised Explosive Device (IED) planted by terrorists on the Srinagar-Baramulla highway in Jammu and Kashmir on Wednesday, officials said here. Security forces noticed a briefcase placed by the roadside at Narbal on the highway at around 7 am, the officials said. item.title: 5 HDFC Bank employees arrested in J-K for financial fraud
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 18 : Five HDFC employees have been arrested in connection with a large-scale financial fraud in the Shopian district of Jammu and Kashmir.
